rows.title: A very long task title that has to wrap inside a narrow dashboard column without clipping
rows.card:
Done: measured the cold start on both hosts and read the release notes of every dependency touched by the upgrade path
Problem: The upgrade keeps the old cache format for one release, which doubles disk use on small hosts for about two weeks.
Dropping it now forces a full rebuild on first start, about twenty minutes of downtime per host that nobody watches.
1. Keep the old format - + no host rebuilds during this release; - double disk use on small hosts for two weeks ★
2. Drop it now - + one cache format from the next start; - one full rebuild per host on first start
3. Ask each host owner first - + owners pick their downtime; - the release slips by a week
To answer: `taskq answer 9.K` or comment `K` or the option text.
